parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
arrivals - returns bookings arriving today
departures - confirmed, new and request bookings departing today
new - returns bookings created in the past 24 hours
current - returns bookings with a check-in before or on today and a check out after or on today
By default, filters will only return bookings with a status of of confirmed, new or request.
All dates are in the property's time zone.
